text:
**Summary:** Pivot Mobile is raising postpaid plan prices from the first bill after 15 November 2026, while also increasing data.

- **Small:** $35 → $38 (20GB → 30GB)
- **Medium:** $45 → $49 (60GB → 80GB)
- **Large:** $60 → $65 (150GB → 200GB)

**Who's affected:** Only customers on current plans (introduced March 2024). Customers on the older "Classic" plans are unchanged this year. Customers on fixed 12- or 24-month contracts see no change until their contract ends.

**Options:** Customers can leave or switch plans without an exit fee if they do so before 15 November. Device repayments still apply.

**Reason:** Higher network costs and investment in regional coverage, including 120 new sites in Queensland and Western Australia.

**Support:** In-app chat or 13 PIVOT, 8am–8pm daily.
